description: This file defines schema for various protocol message types and data validation rules used internally in Playwright for communicating commands and events related to browser automation, including page, frame, element, network, and other browser context operations.

classes.name: StackFrame
classes.description: Represents a call frame in a stack trace, including file, line, column, and function name.

classes.name: Metadata
classes.description: Holds metadata information such as location, title, internal flag, and step identifier.

classes.name: ClientSideCallMetadata
classes.description: Contains metadata for client-side calls, including an ID and optional stack trace.

classes.name: Point
classes.description: Defines a 2D point with x and y coordinates.

classes.name: Rect
classes.description: Defines a rectangle with position and size attributes.

classes.name: SerializedValue
classes.description: Represents serialized data values including numbers, booleans, strings, special values, binary data, objects, arrays, references, and error objects.

classes.name: SerializedArgument
classes.description: An object wrapping a serialized value along with handles for element references.

classes.name: ExpectedTextValue
classes.description: Schema for expected text conditions, including string, regex, ignore case, and whitespace normalization.

classes.name: SelectorEngine
classes.description: Descriptor for a selector engine with name, source code, and optional content script flag.

classes.name: SetNetworkCookie
classes.description: Schema for setting a network cookie with various optional attributes like domain, expiry, etc.

classes.name: NetworkCookie
classes.description: Represents a network cookie with strict required attributes.

classes.name: NameValue
classes.description: Key-value pair, typically for headers or cookies.

classes.name: IndexedDBDatabase
classes.description: Schema for an IndexedDB database, including stores, records, and indexes.

classes.name: SetOriginStorage
classes.description: Schema for origin storage, containing local storage and IndexedDB data.

classes.name: OriginStorage
classes.description: Schema representing origin storage with localStorage and IndexedDB data.

classes.name: SerializedError
classes.description: Serialization format for errors, with message, name, and optional stack trace.

classes.name: RecordHarOptions
classes.description: Options for recording HAR files, including mode, url filters, and content inclusion.

classes.name: FormField
classes.description: Defines a form field, including name, value, and optional file upload info.

classes.name: SDKLanguage
classes.description: Enumeration of supported SDK languages like JavaScript, Python, Java, C#.

classes.name: APIRequestContextInitializer
classes.description: Initialization schema for API request context, including tracing channel.

classes.name: APIRequestContextFetchParams
classes.description: Parameters for fetching network requests, including URL, method, headers, body, retries, etc.

classes.name: APIRequestContextFetchResult
classes.description: Result structure containing the response.

classes.name: APIRequestContextFetchResponseBodyParams
classes.description: Params for fetching response body identified by a fetch UID.

classes.name: APIRequestContextFetchResponseBodyResult
classes.description: Object containing the binary response data.

classes.name: APIRequestContextFetchLogParams
classes.description: Parameters to fetch logs for a request identified by fetch UID.

classes.name: APIRequestContextFetchLogResult
classes.description: Contains a list of log messages.

classes.name: APIRequestContextStorageStateParams
classes.description: Parameters to retrieve storage state, like cookies and origins.

classes.name: APIRequestContextStorageStateResult
classes.description: Container for cookies and origins.

classes.name: APIResponse
classes.description: Represents an HTTP response with fetch UID, URL, status, headers.

classes.name: LifecycleEvent
classes.description: Enum for page lifecycle events like load, domcontentloaded, networkidle, commit.

methods.name: findValidator
methods.description: Finds validator for a given schema type.

methods.name: maybeFindValidator
methods.description: Optionally finds a validator if exists.

methods.name: createMetadataValidator
methods.description: Creates a validator for metadata objects.
